The variables chosen for analysis are education expenditure (from the Adjusted_savings_education_expenditure_percentage_of_GNI.csv dataset), per capita GDP (from the GNI_per_capita_constant_2015_USdollar.csv dataset), and economic output (inferred from the exports of goods and services dataset). However, due to the issues encountered with the data, the statistical significance of the relationship could not be determined.
